name: id
description: The ID of the tabs component.

name: idPrefix
description: Optional prefix. This is used to prefix the `id` attribute for each tab item and panel, separated by `-`. Defaults to the `id` option value.

name: visuallyHiddenText
description: Visually hidden heading for the tabs contents list items. Defaults to `"Contents"`.

params.name: id
params.description: Specific `id` attribute for the tab item. If omitted, then `idPrefix` string is required instead.

params.name: label
params.description: The text label of a tab item.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tab.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the tab panel. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the tab panel. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.
